uk P1-20 JacquetPSI2012 paper rev3 1 Introduction During the application of Ion Cyclotron Range of Frequency (ICRF) heating, local heat deposition in the vicinity of the antennas is commonly observed as was reported in Tore- Supra [1] and JET [2]
This phenomenon is attributed to the interaction of ICRF waves with the SOL plasma through RF sheath rectification [3][4]
Infra-red (IR) thermography was used with the JET carbon (C) wall to quantify heat-fluxes on the protection septa of the JET A2 antennas [2]
